title: Case: Recipient requests a call shortly before arrival
context: The route is booked, but the customer needs time to move from a nearby studio to the delivery door. The driver has not yet departed.
initial_request: Could the driver call shortly before reaching me? I work in the studio next door and need a few minutes to walk over. Use my saved order contact.

events.body: This month's partner bulletin: new van livery rolling out across the northern depots, revised fuel surcharge table attached to the portal, and a reminder that the summer peak forecast is now published. To stop receiving these emails, update your preferences.
Hi, any update on DL-43564? It was meant to come Wednesday. Thanks.

events.from: IT service desk, Rivet Delivery Desk
events.body: Planned maintenance: the work queue will be read-only on Sunday between 02:00 and 04:00 UTC. Messages sent in that window are queued and delivered afterwards.

acceptable_actions.summary: Send the recipient's agreed callback request to dispatch.

must_not: Recorded instruction is not proof of a call or of arrival.
Acts on, or mentions to the recipient of this case, any of the unrelated messages about other shipments
expected.reference_message: Please record Nerys’s request on DL-3711: call the verified saved order contact shortly before arrival, if route conditions allow. No contact change is requested.

rationale: Rule-made from delivery-004: people, organisations and references renamed, dates moved 728 days. 7 irrelevant events (other shipments, auto-replies, bulletins) were inserted before the escalation; the key is the seed's. The answer key is the seed's, carried through the same renaming.
